Match every explicitly named visual attribute in the subtask exactly, including object type, color, and relative location. A similarly shaped object with a different named attribute is a distractor, not the destination. There is no valid previous-goal point in the current view. The flight verifier or planner rejected the previous proposal: planner reported infeasible: exploratory corridor contains no executable segment. Rejected points in the current coordinate system: [(499, 500), (500, 500)]. Do not repeat or choose near those points. Select a visibly open, traversable continuation that makes progress around the obstruction. Return only JSON with integer u and v. Do not report distance, world coordinates, completion, or flight controls.
